entries.description: A lesbian-owned and operated business selling handcrafted work of women.
entries.raw_text: WOMENCRAFTS: We are a lesbian-owned and operated business and carry the handcrafted work of over 150 women, including jewelry, pottery, batiks, toys, chairs, stained glass, planthangers, and much more. A 6 ft. Amazon carving guards our door. We're open May thru Oct. and possibly weekends until December. Come and see us when you're in Provincetown. Womencrafts, 373 Commercial St. (Pepe's Wharf). Any lesbians with arts or crafts to sell or consign to a lesbian business, please write: Womencrafts, PO Box 190, Provincetown, MA, 02657. We need inexpensive things to sell to tourists as well as beautiful work especially for women.
entries.notes: Not a listing: this is a business, not a land community.

entries.contact_street_address: Dept. of English, U. of N.
entries.description: A research project on lesbian slang and community.
entries.raw_text: LESBIAN HUMOR: I am doing a paper on "Gay Slang and the Issue of Community: Are You One, Too?" It will show how lesbian slang and humor differ from straight and gay male slang. The most important aspect that we intend to stress is its lack of personal derogation. Any suggestions, comments, jokes, or input of any kind should be sent to: Julia Stanley, Dept. of English, U. of N., Lincoln, Nebraska, 68588.

entries.contact_street_address: Women's Center, SF State Student Union, 1600 Holloway
entries.description: A conference on violence against women.
entries.raw_text: VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN: Conference at San Francisco State University, on Oct. 16 and 17 to explore the many kinds of violence in the lives of all women, and to seek possible solutions. For more info, write: Women's Center, SF State Student Union, 1600 Holloway, SF, CA, 94132 - Attn: Shoshana Rosenberg.

entries.description: An educational and fundraising multimedia caravan seeking to schedule stops.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND: plans an educational and fundraising multi-media caravan in early fall. Slides, movies, literature, puppet shows, music, trade & barter, speeches, conversation and connection. West Coast & Southwest & ? Write to schedule a stop in your area. OWL, PO Box 1713, Eugene, OR, 97401.
entries.notes: Type is Land Fund/Seeking Land as they plan an educational and fundraising caravan. Focus on archives/cultural work for multimedia/literature/puppet shows presentation.

entries.description: A conference on FBI and grand jury harassment.
entries.raw_text: HEALTHY PARANOIA: a conference on the FBI and grand jury's harassment of the lesbian and women's communities, Sept. 18 & 19 in Ann Arbor. Registration is $3. For more info, write: Healthy Paranoia, 3415 Michigan Union, U. of M., Ann Arbor, MI, 48104.

entries.description: A press collective seeking submissions for an anthology.
entries.raw_text: MATRIA PRESS COLLECTIVE: an open collective of feminist women, is requesting submission of graphics, poetry, and short prose for its third anthology. Due Oct. 1. Include SASE. Write: Matria Press, 816 Hazen SE, Grand Rapids, MI, 49507 - Phone (616) 243-2895.
entries.notes: Not a listing: publishing collective seeking art/writing.

For more info, write: Celebration: A Florida Feminist Festival, c/o Karen L. Bolesky, Terrace Village, Shopping Center, 10940 56th St., Room 203, Temple Terrace, FL, 33617 - Phone (813) 985-5625, or 381-4828.

entries.contact_street_address: Women Health Care Project, 1711 Ocean Park Blvd.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S HEALTH AND HEALING CONFERENCE: Oct. 8-11, Los Angeles City College, 1855 N. Vermont. Panels, speakers and workshops on Women as Healers, Health Care vs. Sick Care, and Sexism and Medicine. Registration is $30, unemployed $10 (at door). Also singing and sharing women's culture, Holly Near. Write: Women Health Care Project, 1711 Ocean Park Blvd., Santa Monica, CA, 90405 - Ph. (213) 450-2191.

GAY FICTION MAGAZINE: lesbians and gay men are invited to submit manuscripts of quality work for a new quarterly magazine of gay fiction to be published in SF next year. Graphic arts will also be included. Include SASE. Write: Gay Faction Magazine, 631 Castro St., San Francisco, CA, 94114.
entries.notes: Not a listing: publication seeking submissions.

entries.description: A radical publications collective seeking full-time people.
entries.raw_text: SOURCE: radical publications collective, needs full-time people dedicated to political change and hard work, and collective lifestyle. Room/Board provided. Write: Box 21066, Washington, DC, 20009.

entries.raw_text: HERSHELF: wimmin's bookstore at 2 Highland, Highland Park, MI, 48203, is now open Wed., Thurs., & Fri., 2-7 PM and Sun. Noon to 5. We stock books, music, and crafts by, for and about wimmin. We also have discussion groups and music and poetry sharing. Stop in or call 869-4045.

entries.description: A support group for Native American women.
entries.raw_text: SUPPORT NATIVE AMERICAN WOMEN: The oppression of native peoples stretches far. Women have been and still are a strong force fighting for native American sovereignty. These women are ignored by the media in their confrontation and struggle with the FBI. We must learn about and support these women. For general info, write: Women Supporting Native American Sovereignty, c/o Mother Kali's Bookstore, 333 W. 11th, EUGENE, OR, 97401.
entries.notes: Not a listing: solidarity support group.

entries.contact_street_address: Congregation Beth Ishah, c/o Sarak Ravinsky, 643 Ritner St.
entries.raw_text: FEMINIST SYNAGOGUE IN PHILA: Are you a Philadelphia womon who is Jewish? If so, come to our Friday night services. Services will be starting in Sept. All women welcome. We are a totally non-sexist, women's synagogue, trying to make Judaism relate to our feminism. Write: Congregation Beth Ishah, c/o Sarak Ravinsky, 643 Ritner St., Philadelphia, PA, 19148 - Phone HO - 5 - 2605.

entries.description: Metropolitan Community Churches information for gay worship.
entries.raw_text: A CHURCH FOR GAYS: Any lesbian who is interested in worshipping God in a church without discrimination and with an outreach to gays (women and men) there are such churches all over the world. Metropolitan Community Churches are for all religious backgrounds. For more info, write: La Verne Barnhill, MCC, PO Box 39235, Cincinnati, OH, 45239.

entries.contact_street_address: Women's Motor Club, 30161 Southfield Rd., Suite 203
entries.description: A club for car maintenance and insurance savings for women.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S MOTOR CLUB: We can save you money on insurance, repairs and even your new car purchase. We also have a newsletter with issues, written for women, discussing different aspects of car care and what to do if you have an accident. For more info, write: Women's Motor Club, 30161 Southfield Rd., Suite 203, Southfield, MI 48076.
